name: Clyde Atkins
source:
He is from Esu as well! He's all about creating new inventions, although... oftentimes, he'll fail. But it never stops him! 
Seemingly, he is a guy without any problems. So far, Yukio has helped the lives of Douglas and Yasusuke... but... What can possibly Yukio do to help Clyde? He doesn't even have a problem?! Will his appearance just add more trouble to Yukio's current life with his craziness?! Clyde is always smiling and trying to be happy.
